# 02_Logos (yellow style)

The logo in this style's colours. Four layouts (wide, stacked, icon, wordmark) and five colourways (full colour, single colour, black, white, on colour). PNG files have transparent backgrounds except on-colour. SVG files are clean vectors. `animation-ready/` has every part on its own layer.

## Folders

| Folder | What is in it |
|---|---|
| [`animation-ready/`](animation-ready/) | For animating the logo yourself (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut ...). |
| [`png-4096/`](png-4096/) | Every layout and colourway as a PNG 4096 px wide (transparent background, except the on-colour ones). |
| [`png-512/`](png-512/) | Every layout and colourway as a PNG 512 px wide, for quick use on screen. |
| [`svg/`](svg/) | Every layout and colourway as an SVG: clean vector shapes that scale to any size. |
